verdicts.about: Treat the opt-in as live only while the model is cached; re-offer when evicted
verdicts.why: Took the case: eviction must lead to a fresh download. Turned down the re-shown grey offer line: the opt-in stands, so the press downloads at once and a modal just says the model went missing and is coming back, with a lone OK.

verdicts.about: Release the held model on hot reload so an engine edit takes effect
verdicts.why: Turned down: nothing extra for local testing, only no leaked GPU memory, which globalThis already gives; a changed model needs a page reload, accepted.

verdicts.about: Hold the tab only while the weights download, not while loading from cache
verdicts.why: Taken as proposed with a bare yes.

verdicts.about: Clear the field on unlock so no verdict table appears beside the bulb
verdicts.why: Turned down: the phrase left in the field and checked as a name is part of the easter egg.
